operating_notes.text: Acquired a 5,000 sq. meter plant in Dahej SEZ from Axiom Chemicals Private Limited for cash.
Share Purchase Agreement dated 20 August 2026 amended on 22 October 2026 to delete Clause 9.5 (Lock-in) and Clause 9.6 (RoFR) on erstwhile promoters' 9.95% stake.

timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (standalone): revenue ₹26.13 Cr; net profit ₹8 Cr (+26.6% YoY).

Jogindersingh Jaswal (Chairman & MD), Ketanramani (WTD), and Pritesh Ramani (WTD) jointly with PAC disclosed holding 97,96,400 shares of KRONOX LAB SCIENCES LIMITED as of March 31, 2026, with no encumbrances filed on April 4, 2026.
Kronox Lab Sciences approved the acquisition of a 5,000 sq. meter plant in Dahej SEZ from Axiom Chemicals for cash.
Kronox Lab informed of an SPA amendment between Indo Borax and erstwhile promoters removing lock-in and RoFR on their 9.95% stake.
